comment: 0x28-byte pad SIF RPC client bound to server 0x80000100; used for synchronous pad RPC requests.

name: pad_secondary_rpc_client
comment: 0x28-byte pad SIF RPC client bound to server 0x80000101; bind completion checks its word at +0x24.

name: pad_client_slots
comment: Two ports by four slots of 0x1C-byte libpad client records; track input DMA, direct commands, IOP destination and open state.

name: pad_direct_commands
comment: Two ports by four slots of 0x20-byte actuator direct-command blocks; port open installs each block in its client slot.

name: pad_rpc_buffer
comment: Shared 0x80-byte synchronous pad SIF RPC request/reply buffer; reused by port and callback configuration.

name: pad_dma_callback_gp
comment: Saved caller GP installed under interrupt exclusion and restored while invoking the optional DMA completion callback.

name: pad_dma_completion_callback
comment: Optional callback pointer installed by pad_set_dma_completion_callback and invoked with the IOP VBlank counter.

name: card_rpc_initialized_state
comment: Card RPC initialized-state word; zero rejects submissions with -100, and initialization clears it on RPC or module-version failure.

name: card_rpc_request_handle
comment: First word of the shared 0x30-byte card RPC request buffer; close, read, write and flush store their file handle here before submission.

name: card_rpc_directory_request
comment: Shared 0x414-byte path/directory request area; get-directory command 0x0D sets port, slot, mode, maximum rows, destination and pattern; the existing type is a partial pattern view.

name: card_rpc_completed_result
comment: Card RPC response result word; card_rpc_wait copies the completed byte count or error to the caller after completion.

name: rng_mt_state
comment: MT19937 state: 624 eight-byte slots holding low32 words; rng_initialize rebuilds them, and prng_next twists and reads the shared array.

name: font_texture_owner
comment: Resident font texture base; font_draw_text binds its address to active render environment +0x128 at 0x001881EC and 0x001890AC before render_prepare_bound_texture, including after the embedded callback; initialized through texture_initialize_from_descriptor by the call chain at 0x001864E0-0x001864F4 and 0x0019F080.

name: stage_render_descriptor
comment: Resident default stage-render descriptor; battle_initialize_render_descriptor initializes and binds it, bg_factory_render_coefficients writes its two coefficients, and battle_dispatch_phases selects it.

name: stage_render_packet_coefficient
comment: Alias of StageRenderDescriptor.packet_coefficient at stage_render_descriptor+0x24; factory 17 writes token 1 and model_build_packet copies it to packet+0x204; default 0.3.

name: stage_render_color_coefficient
comment: Alias of StageRenderDescriptor.color_coefficient at stage_render_descriptor+0x28; factory 17 writes token 0 and model_build_packet multiplies it by 128 and optional opacity for the color high byte; default 0.4.

name: tone_shade_default_destination
comment: Resident default tone destination initialized by model_renderer_static_initialize; destination destruction and battle dispatch restore the current tone pointer to it.

name: attachment_force
comment: Four-component force vector passed by attachment_manager_step to attachment integration and added to retained velocity; oscillating_composition_step initializes all four components from vf0 and replaces Z.

name: attachment_z_lower_bound
comment: Z lower bound loaded by attachment_manager_step and forwarded through attachment_chain_integrate; attachment_state_integrate clamps current-point Z to this float after collision projection.

name: ccs_animation_track_scratch
comment: Base of packed-animation scratch rows: encoded record ID (ID*4+1) and key-descriptor word; ccs_parse_animation_tracks passes it to dispatch at 0x001A2A18 and reads eight-byte rows at 0x001A2A60..0x001A2A9C; only the leading row is typed, full allocation extent unestablished.

name: default_particle_manager
comment: Resident default ccParticleManager used when generator-action ownership is null; engine_root_finish_update updates and draws it under the low-three-bit engine gate.

name: battle_effect_first_phase_enabled
comment: Effect-system first-phase enable byte set or cleared by battle_dispatch_phases from allowed_first_third mask bit 7.

name: battle_effect_second_phase_enabled
comment: Effect-system second-phase enable byte set or cleared by battle_dispatch_phases from allowed_second mask bit 7.

name: environment_candidates
comment: Resident 32-slot EnvironmentCandidate buffer with 0x60-byte stride; segment and swept-sphere admission overwrite slot 31 after capacity is reached.

name: environment_candidate_overflow_slot
comment: Alias of environment_candidates[31], reused for every accepted overflow hit; it is not separate scratch storage.

name: environment_published_candidate
comment: Environment result partially copied by environment_publish_nearest from the nearest retained candidate, choosing the last equal-distance entry.

name: environment_published_primitive_flags
comment: Alias of environment_published_candidate.primitive_flags at +0x48, carrying the chosen triangle flags.

name: card_directory_cache
comment: Shared 0x40-byte directory-row cache; preflight requests up to 24 entries, smaller queries reuse its prefix, and the timestamp comparator reads rows 3 through 7.

name: default_extra_pass_descriptor
comment: Resident default 0x34-byte optional-pass descriptor constructed by model_default_extra_pass_initialize through transient_manager_aux_construct at 0x005D7AEC/0x005D7AF0; projectile_manager_member_destruct restores model_extra_pass_descriptor to this block at 0x001C4434..0x001C443C when the published block is destroyed.

name: audio_player_one_packet
comment: Player-one 0x100-byte compact-audio packet; initializer sets capacity 0xF4, used zero, trailer one and appends C0 00 through its append handle.

name: audio_player_two_packet
comment: Player-two 0x100-byte compact-audio packet; initializer sets capacity 0xF4, used zero, trailer one and appends C0 00 through its append handle.

name: audio_player_one_append_handle
comment: Player-one compact-audio append handle; streams pointer reaches the one-row table referring to audio_player_one_packet.

name: audio_player_two_append_handle
comment: Player-two compact-audio append handle; streams pointer reaches the one-row table referring to audio_player_two_packet.

name: audio_auxiliary_words
comment: Sixteen resident auxiliary audio words reset to -1 by sound_rpc_task after fade servicing and before queued parameter servicing; wider consumer meaning remains open.

name: audio_stereo_work_areas
comment: Three stereo ADXT player work areas; audio_stream_manager_construct assigns base plus slot*0x1C1E4, and audio_players_initialize passes each with two channels and 0x1C1E4 bytes.

name: audio_mono_work_areas
comment: Three mono ADXT player work areas; audio_stream_manager_construct assigns base plus slot*0x11924, and audio_players_initialize passes each with one channel and 0x11924 bytes.

name: audio_mono_buffers
comment: Three 0x3000-byte mono-player buffers; audio_stream_manager_construct assigns base plus slot*0x3000 and audio_players_initialize attaches each to its mono stream.

name: audio_common_append_handle
comment: Common compact-audio append handle; streams pointer reaches the one-row table referring to audio_common_packet.

name: audio_common_packet
comment: Common 0x100-byte compact-audio packet; initializer sets capacity 0xF4, used zero, trailer one and appends C0 00.

name: audio_rpc_buffer
comment: First word of shared RPC send/reply storage; ordinary commands store their payload here and send 0x10 bytes, replies return here and bank loading compares it with the descriptor completion value.

name: audio_bank_load_descriptor
comment: Shared bank-load RPC descriptor; audio_load_character_bank writes IOP allocation, source file offset, allocation size, completion sample extent, placement and filename before RPC 0x9400. | shared:SNDBASE.IRX:sndbase_load_bank_disc reads word0 as IOP header pointer,4 as source byte offset,8 as header bytes,C as SPU sample byte count,14 as SPU destination,18 as filename; word10 not read by this loader.

name: audio_bank_load_completion_value
comment: Unsigned completion-value field at audio_bank_load_descriptor+0x0C; character load stores the bank sample extent and compares this word with audio_rpc_buffer before clearing loading. | RPC9400's returned transferred-SPU-byte count must equal this sample-byte count to advance character bank load.

name: audio_packet_dma_descriptor
comment: Four-word resident SIF DMA descriptor populated by audio_submit_packet_dma at offsets 0/4/8/0x0C and passed to sceSifSetDma with count one.

name: character_appearance_holders
comment: Three family-indexed pairs of shared nine-entry appearance lookup holders, indexed by actor; initialized by character_appearance_holders_initialize and read by character_appearance_select.

name: character_selection_containers
comment: Borrowed 2BOD1, 1BOD1 and 3EYE containers for two actors; manager_publish_six_selections retains ccs_find_container results including zero, and character_lookup_holder_initialize reads them.

name: character_selection_filenames
comment: 2BOD1, 1BOD1 and 3EYE basenames for two actors, published by manager_publish_six_selections after clearing character-ID flag 0x100; its lookup loop uses each name to select the corresponding borrowed container and packed character code.

name: character_selection_codes
comment: Three-byte character codes packed into family/actor-indexed words by manager_publish_six_selections; character_resource_name_format copies the low three bytes over literal xxx.

name: save_status_messages
comment: 48-entry save-status text pointer table; save_status_text_get indexes four-byte pointers with the low 12 status bits.

name: end_demo_character_request_path
comment: Selected-character 3EYE request path buffer formatted by end_demo_request_character_ccs and passed to container lookup and unique-load enqueue; full buffer extent is unestablished.

name: battle_countdown
comment: Resident round countdown with flags and fixed-point remaining/elapsed/limit/delta fields.

name: battle_countdown_remaining
comment: Current remaining fixed-point battle countdown word; battle_save_reentry_values captures it and battle_restore_reentry_values restores it for mask bit 0x10.

name: battle_countdown_elapsed
comment: Current elapsed fixed-point battle countdown word; battle_save_reentry_values captures it and battle_restore_reentry_values restores it for mask bit 0x10.

name: battle_countdown_remaining_snapshot
comment: Saved remaining battle countdown word copied from the current remaining word during reentry capture and restored for mask bit 0x10.

name: battle_countdown_elapsed_snapshot
comment: Saved elapsed battle countdown word copied from the current elapsed word during reentry capture and restored for mask bit 0x10.

name: session_outcomes
comment: Resident six-word session outcome and streak tally; reset at outer startup and updated after teardown.

name: encounter_sequence_data
comment: Resident data object assigned to EncounterFlow.sequence_data by rng_shuffle_allocate; complete layout remains unestablished.

name: resident_bindings_bank0
comment: First of three contiguous 0x10-byte resident binding banks; bindings_update copies eight halfwords of resident_default_bindings to each bank on reset.

name: resident_bindings_port0
comment: Controller-port-0 binding bank at bank index 1; bindings_update repopulates eight halfwords and manager_setup copies them to SaveProfile.bindings[0].

name: resident_bindings_port1
comment: Controller-port-1 binding bank at bank index 2; bindings_update repopulates eight halfwords and manager_setup copies them to SaveProfile.bindings[1].

name: side_condition_statuses
comment: Three banks of 0x5D signed 32-bit condition statuses; side_condition_init sets every slot to -1.

name: side_one_uj_defeat_latch
comment: side_condition_statuses[1][7]; value 1 is the attacker-side UJ defeat latch blocking form replacement, and -1 is the reset value.

name: side_two_uj_defeat_latch
comment: side_condition_statuses[2][7]; value 1 is the attacker-side UJ defeat latch blocking form replacement, and -1 is the reset value.

name: side_jutsu_tier_remaps
comment: Per-side signed-byte Ultimate Jutsu tier remaps at row stride 0xC; side_jutsu_tier_remap reads offsets 0..2, initialized to identity values 0,1,2.

name: fighter_statistics_banks
comment: External per-side fighter-statistics bank base at stride 0x2D6; stats_save_side_bank and stats_load_side_bank copy the first 24 signed-halfword count/max pairs (0x60 bytes).

name: common_effect_resources
comment: Borrowed common effect resource pointers indexed by effect ID; effect_resolve_common_resources fills IDs 0..0x6A from effect0x and 0x6B..0x9B from particle, and effect_set_identifier passes them to wrapped_resource_setup; initializer clears 0x274 bytes.

name: common_effect_star00
comment: Common-effect slot 29 populated by effect_resolve_common_resources from EFFECT0X EFF_e0xstar00; read by retained TND pattern-1 emitter.

name: sp_skill_override_main_path
comment: Character buffer for the opponent-specific main resident path; sp_skill_find_stream_override copies the matched stream path here at 0x0035C9C0-0x0035C9CC and replaces .ccs with e.ccs; sp_skill_build_requests selects it at 0x0035CCB4-0x0035CCB8. Buffer capacity remains unestablished.

name: progressive_text_buffer
comment: Resident short-text buffer selected by text_draw_progressive when string length plus terminator is below 0x200; larger strings use a temporary system allocation.
